Hi Laura — attaching the package for your SOC 2 review. We included both the VPC-managed Private flow and an on-prem appendix per your potential SIG follow-up.

Summary (short):
- Control-plane / data-plane separation: control-plane endpoints live in a dedicated management subnet with mTLS and role-based access. Data-plane GPU pools are in isolated tenant subnets; requests are routed via workload proxies with per-tenant KV cache isolation.
- Network isolation controls: VPC peering uses explicit route tables (no transitive peering), security groups + host-level iptables for runtime hardening, egress policy enforced at an egress-proxy with allow-listing, and NAT gateways placed in shared services for controlled outbound.
- Tenant traffic evidence: we included a redacted egress CSV excerpt and the segmentation matrix showing logical namespace assignments and enforcement points.
- Shared services: logging & metrics are forwarded to a multi-tenant observability cluster with per-tenant indices and strict RBAC. The control plane uses mutual TLS and per-customer service account scoping.

Attachments included: network-diagram-v2.png (image/png); control-plane-boundary.pdf (application/pdf); egress-policy-csv.csv (text/csv); segmentation-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
